## Outcome

Describe what this change makes possible.

## Scope

- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Catalog/profile change
- [ ] New or changed lab manifest
- [ ] Infrastructure or application implementation
- [ ] Repository tooling

## Validation

- [ ] `pwsh ./scripts/Test-Catalog.ps1`
- [ ] Relevant compatibility check
- [ ] Implementation-specific formatting and tests
- [ ] Real sandbox run, if claiming `verified`

## Safety and sources

- [ ] No credentials, real identifiers, Terraform state, or unsanitized evidence
- [ ] Sandbox compromises are labeled
- [ ] Production extensions are documented
- [ ] Capability claims cite current primary sources
- [ ] No paid course content or exam material is reproduced
